title: Platform Supportability Common Definitions (BUILD-005 Slice 1)
description: Reusable bounded supportability definitions. Machine-testable contract only. SPECIFIED != IMPLEMENTED != TESTED != CERTIFIED. No Prometheus/OTel Collector/metrics DB. No runtime conformance in Slice 1.

utcTimestamp.description: Canonical UTC timestamp field name is ts.

correlationId.description: Opaque correlation identifier. Not tenant/auth authority. Not telemetry batch/stream/sequence/assignment/fencing identity.

eventCode.description: Canonical operational event/error code field. Legacy JSON key error_code is non-canonical.

tenantId.description: Canonical tenant UUID when present. Do not invent a tenant ID.

serviceInstanceId.description: Unique to one process/runtime instance; changes after restart; non-secret; immutable during one process; not persistent node/sensor/agent authority; not tenant authorization.

componentName.description: Canonical component identity field. Legacy JSON key service is non-canonical.

message.description: Human-readable message. Canonical field is message; msg is non-canonical.

safeContext.description: Bounded extension object for non-secret contextual fields. Max 16 properties. Keys bounded. Primitive values only. No nested objects/arrays.

httpSemantic.description: Probe HTTP semantic for readiness. DEGRADED with ready=true uses 200.

nonGoals.description: BUILD-005 Slice 1 explicitly does not introduce Prometheus, OpenTelemetry Collector, sidecars, metrics databases, queues/topics, or external monitoring services.
